content.question: Which property makes L1-regularization (Lasso) useful for feature selection?
options: It pushes many coefficients exactly to zero, effectively removing those features.
It distributes the penalty evenly across all correlated features.
It squares the coefficients, which amplifies the contribution of weak features.
It automatically removes the hyperparameter from the loss function.
content.answer: It pushes many coefficients exactly to zero, effectively removing those features.
